decision.reason: The Stage2 ownership probe predated the security rule that public normalizeConfined rejects every device and extended namespace. It queried the Windows current directory, converted the trusted runtime canonical \\?\ path back to Text, and incorrectly sent that untrusted spelling through the public validator. The runtime and stdlib correctly returned Err, so the stale probe printed false after all 43 seed fixtures had passed. The probe now keeps the canonical Path owned and validates its nonempty payload; the relative owned Result normalization remains the first half of the fixture. Normalize retained historical verification observations to the existing record contract. Original JSON and terminal outputs remain preserved unchanged. Recorded baseline timeout/cancellation and orphan evidence is retained, not relabeled as current success. No current input compatibility, whole-goal acceptance, new test execution or speed claim.
